text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Trainer had such a sad look the whole time... In the end, I couldn't get through to them properly.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I'm the one who dragged you into this. Yet, you were just kind enough to let me run.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer.
But I'm sure it'll be ready soon."

"And so, as K.S. Miracle
continued running,
it began to rain."
The overcast skies that had lingered since morning finally gave way to a downpour of heavy, violent rain, as if weeping at last.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
! ...Excuse me.
May I take the seat next to you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Of course.
...It started raining all of a sudden, didn't it?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, you're soaking wet...
I'm sorry, I wish I could lend you a jacket,
but mine is drenched too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Things just aren't going well, in so many ways...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Come to think of it, since we have separate rooms at the training camp, it feels like it's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Have you lost a bit of weight?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(After that, Ruby said nothing more.
She just stared at the sky until the rain stopped.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Silently watching, endlessly, as the weeping sky poured down.)
